en: The xenos have summoned their daemonic Avatar, a towering warrior of flame.

en: The planetary capital of Calderis, this rugged town has suffered under the predations of both bandits and xenos.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: Make your way to the rendezvous point for extraction. Beware - the hive is awakening
zh_new: 前往會合點撤離。小心，蟲巢正在甦醒。
notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: And our lasguns will take care of any that get through.

en: You must gather a bio-toxin sample from a primary Tyranid hive.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: Perhaps these artifacts were quarantined for the populace's protection.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: Or the nobles in the governor's palace have a stake in this black market.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: Highly aggressive worm-like creatures are appearing in wilderness areas.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: The numerous magma vents are raising the planet's temperature. This is sparking the growth of yet more plants for the hive to consume.
zh_new: 大量岩漿噴口正在提高行星溫度，進一步刺激更多供蟲巢吞噬的植物生長。
notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: The Tyrant is dead. It will not build another hive, just yet.
zh_new: 暴君死了。至少暫時它不會再建造另一座蟲巢。
notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: A brood of the aliens have infested this region and must be driven back.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: Our Librarians feel the might of the Hive Mind channeled into the Tyrant, so expect it to be a powerful opponent.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: Strike down this Tyrant, and the hive mind will suffer.

en: The death of the Tyrant has caused the hive mind to recoil and the infestation to lessen.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: Many of his vital organs and implants were destroyed and an alien poison is attacking surviving tissues.
zh_new: 他的許多重要器官和植入體被摧毀，異族毒素正在攻擊倖存組織。
notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: The Hive Fleet is already depositing billions of alien organisms on our worlds.

notes: 2026-05-17 13:18 JST main chat xenos/Tyranid readable cleanup

en: We are receiving numerous reports of local vegetation mutating, and attacks by hordes of leaping alien creatures.

en: Imperial Shrines allow us to face our alien foes with increased fortitude and resolve.

en: This might is slowing the infestation, and the alien mind clearly wishes to see that resistance end.
